boundary_observations.table_row_quantity: manufactured-graphite lattice c_v derived from c_p - c_w - c_e

mapping_contract.source_relation: c_p = c_v + c_w + c_e; c_v = c_p - c_w - c_e
mapping_contract.provided_units: cal g^-1 K^-1 in source; mass-specific J kg^-1 K^-1 after declared conversion
mapping_contract.required_for_Topic13: uncertainty-grade volumetric c_v or C_src in a declared material regime
mapping_contract.conversion_route: c_v^V = rho*c_v requires source-locked same-regime density and uncertainty

claim_boundary: This source package closes only the scoped no-go that the IAEA Table 4.11 comparator cannot supply uncertainty-grade volumetric c_v or Ding C_src. It does not reject the comparator value; it prevents unsupported uncertainty propagation and material substitution.
